_figmaNamingConvention: Every Figma Variable's literal name = '{primitives|semantic}/' + this JSON's own category/key path unchanged, e.g. primitives/spacing/4, semantic/radius/checkbox. This file's own keys are NOT prefixed — nesting under 'primitives'/'semantic' below already encodes the category for programmatic consumers (tokens.spacing.sm, tokens.color.text.primary, etc. stay as-is). Cross-reference the real Figma name via each entry's figmaId, not by string-matching this file's keys.
_collectionsNote: Two collections only — Primitives and Semantic — per g-di-ads-tokens-author Step 2 and references/token-specifications.md. The 8-collection list in the skill manifest / this template's legacy shape is consolidated: category is expressed by the Variable name prefix, not by a separate collection. Only Semantic carries modes; nothing outside color actually needs a per-theme value, and one Semantic collection keeps every semantic token switchable by a single mode toggle.

white-pure.note: the only non-green-tinted neutral; sits outside the tinted ramp because neutral-0 is #edf3ed

black-pure.note: True black. EXISTS ONLY for single-colour logo reproduction (print separation, engraving, photocopy). NOT a UI colour - the UI near-black is neutral-950 #030903, which carries the brand green tint.

green-neon-700.note: Light-theme data-viz comparison series. green-neon-400 #8fc05d is only 2.13:1 on white, below the 3:1 non-text floor.

legacy-print-sukhumvit.note: legacy/print + logo wordmark ONLY — never bound to any Text Style

opacity._scaleNote: STORED ON THE 0-100 PERCENTAGE SCALE, deliberately. Figma's bound node.opacity field interprets a bound value as a percentage (0-100), NOT a 0-1 fraction. These were originally authored as 0-1 and every binding resolved at exactly 1/100th of intent (0.32 -> 0.0032), silently and with no error. Corrected at QG1 on 2026-08-19 and verified with a live binding probe. The 0-100 scale also matches these tokens' own names (opacity/32 = 32%). EXPORT: divide by 100 for CSS/inline-email opacity, which is 0-1 - see `cssValue` on each entry. DO NOT use these values for a PAINT's opacity literal: Figma paint opacity IS 0-1. Paint opacity cannot be tokenized at all - setBoundVariableForPaint accepts only field 'color', rejecting 'opacity' - so these tokens are exclusively for node-level opacity binding.

0.note: STRING primitive for CSS/email export; the bindable Figma asset is the elevation/0 Effect Style

surface/raised.note: light value authored for gap G12 — it previously aliased the same primitive as surface/default, making a light card invisible

text/secondary.wcag: dark 7.01:1 on surface/page and 5.21:1 on surface/raised - PASSES AA on BOTH by design; light 9.01:1 / 10.15:1
text/secondary.note: Retargeted 2026-08-20 from neutral-500, which gave 5.27:1 on the page but only 3.92:1 on a card - a FAIL that passed on the page surface and so escaped any light-theme-only review. With this value a component may sit on either surface without a per-case audit.

text/secondary-on-raised.note: Resolves the same value as text/secondary since 2026-08-20. Kept for compatibility and intent; prefer text/secondary in new work.

text/disabled.note: light 3.39:1 — permitted only under the WCAG 1.4.3 inactive-control exemption

brand/accent.note: gap G14 — light-theme text/meaningful-icon use PROHIBITED (1.89:1); TEXT_FILL deliberately absent from scopes

border/subtle.note: gap G15 — dark 1.98:1, decorative hairlines only

status/success.note: hue 145 — 33 deg off brand green, >=10 lightness pts apart, per the CP2 collision mitigation

brand/logo-mono.note: IDENTICAL in both themes ON PURPOSE - a one-colour print plate does not invert by theme. Serves logo Theme=black only.

overlay/scrim-fill.note: IDENTICAL in both themes ON PURPOSE - a scrim darkens the content behind it, so it must not invert. A semantic SURFACE token would resolve light in Light mode and render a WHITE scrim. Pair with semantic/opacity/overlay/scrim-* bound to NODE opacity.

data-viz/series-1.note: Series 1 is the brand green family, so a Genesis chart still reads as Genesis. Same primitives as brand/primary and it inverts the same way per theme, but it is a SEPARATE semantic: a brand token must never carry data meaning, which is exactly the defect that put brand/accent into a chart. dashboard_chart Line/Bar/Donut primary marks bind this.

data-viz/series-2.wcag: dark 9.45:1 on page / 7.03:1 on raised; light 3.64:1 on page / 4.10:1 on raised - all clear the 3:1 non-text floor
data-viz/series-2.note: Theme-aware comparison data series. Values UNCHANGED by the 2026-08-20 ramp pass, so the 5 nodes already bound to it did not move. brand/accent could not serve this: its scope guard omits TEXT_FILL but a chart uses SHAPE_FILL, so it slipped through at 2.13:1 on white. CARRIED LIMIT: series-1 <-> series-2 is the one weak adjacency in the ramp - 22.87 deg of hue in Dark and a 1.52:1 mutual ratio (2.52:1 Light). Both are greens. Mitigated by the separator stroke, by naming each series with its value in the legend, and by writing the primary value in the centre of the donut. For a NEW 2-series chart prefer series-1 + series-4.

data-viz/series-3.wcag: dark 7.72:1 on page / 5.74:1 on raised; light 5.60:1 on page / 6.31:1 on raised - all clear 3:1
data-viz/series-3.note: Reuses the amber status primitives rather than inventing a hue. Shares its primitive with status/warning, so any chart using it MUST name every series in the legend (WCAG 1.4.1) - which this DS already mandates for charts.

data-viz/series-4.wcag: dark 7.53:1 on page / 5.60:1 on raised; light 5.79:1 on page / 6.53:1 on raised - all clear 3:1
data-viz/series-4.note: The only hue in the palette on the blue-yellow axis, therefore the ONE series that stays unambiguous under every form of red-green colour vision deficiency. Deliberately placed between series-3 (amber) and series-5 (red), which collapse into each other under deuteranopia. For a 2-series chart that needs maximum separation, pair series-1 with series-4.

data-viz/series-5.wcag: dark 7.37:1 on page / 5.48:1 on raised; light 5.80:1 on page / 6.54:1 on raised - all clear 3:1
data-viz/series-5.note: Reuses the red status primitives. Shares its primitive with status/error: never let a 5th series read as a failure - name it in the legend. Last in the ramp, so do not allocate it unless the chart genuinely has 5 series.

color._dataVizRampComment: Categorical data-visualisation ramp, authored 2026-08-20. 5 series, allocate in index order. Every series clears 3:1 against ALL FOUR surfaces (page/raised x Dark/Light) - the binding case is series-2 Light on surface/page at 3.64:1. Adjacent HUE deltas (Dark): 1<->2 = 22.87, 2<->3 = 52.16, 3<->4 = 176.58, 4<->5 = 151.53 degrees. Only the 1<->2 pair misses the 40 deg aim, and it is the carried LIMIT. Scopes are FRAME_FILL|SHAPE_FILL|STROKE_COLOR on all five, with TEXT_FILL DELIBERATELY ABSENT - that guard is what caught the original brand/accent defect. COLOUR-VISION LIMIT, verified not assumed (Vienot 1999 simulation + CIEDE2000): all four ADJACENT pairs survive both deuteranopia and protanopia (min dE 7.52). Three NON-adjacent pairs collapse: series-1<->3 under protanopia Dark (dE 2.24), series-3<->5 under deuteranopia Light (dE 1.53), series-1<->5 under protanopia Light (dE 2.38). Green, amber and red all map toward yellow under red-green deficiency, so a 5-hue ramp from this palette CANNOT be fully colour-blind safe. The ramp order puts those three at positions 1, 3 and 5 so they are never neighbours. RULE: from 4 series upward, colour alone is insufficient - add a non-colour differentiator (dash pattern, marker shape, hatching) and label the series directly.

component/min-touch-target.note: Minimum interactive target, 24x24. Bind it to the width and height of a TRANSPARENT hit-area frame when the visible control is smaller - never grow the visible node. Standard: WCAG 2.2 criterion 2.5.8 (AA, 24x24). WCAG 2.1 AA sets NO target-size floor; 2.5.5 is AAA and asks for 44x44. Aliases the existing icon-24 primitive rather than duplicating a 24.

sm-md.note: authored for gap G8; named sm-md rather than renumbering the CP2-approved t-shirt scale

component._comment: per-role aliases → primitives.spacing.* — populate incrementally as real component roles appear

typography._comment: every size/weight/lineHeight/letterSpacing traces to a primitives.typography.* entry. fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight and letterSpacing are LIVE-BOUND to those variables on the Figma Text Style; lineHeight is a literal PERCENT by design (a bound FLOAT resolves as PIXELS, which would turn 130% into 130px).

body/sm.note: 14px is a DOCUMENTED deviation from the computed 12.8 — never 'correct' it down

label/tag.note: Reworked by the designer on 2026-09-18 and republished in Figma: size 16 -> 14, family sans -> mono (the one NON-CODE style in Space Mono), textCase ORIGINAL -> UPPER, tracking +20px -> +10px. The +20 that CP2 confirmed as intentional no longer applies — +10 is the value to keep now, and it is still deliberate, so do not normalise it to 0. The primitive behind it was renamed plus-20 -> plus-10 and revalued in the same pass (same VariableID:3:50, no other style used it). textCase is the Figma vocabulary (ORIGINAL|UPPER|LOWER|TITLE); its absence on the other styles means ORIGINAL.

code/block.note: Multi-line code block. 140% is deliberately tighter than body/sm's 160% - code is read line-by-line, not as prose.

code/inline.note: Inline code inside running text. 14px against body/md's 16px because Space Mono has a larger x-height than Plus Jakarta Sans; matching the px would read larger. Keeps 160% so it does not break the surrounding line rhythm.

code/block-strong.note: Emphasis within a code block - a changed line in a diff. Use sparingly: in code, bold competes with syntax highlighting.

opacity._comment: semantic aliases -> primitives.opacity.* - applied as NODE-LEVEL opacity binding only. Values resolve on the 0-100 percentage scale; see primitives.opacity._scaleNote. Verified 2026-08-19: binding state/disabled yields node.opacity 0.32 as intended.

elevation._format: Figma Effect Styles (+ matching STRING variables under primitives.elevation for CSS/email export)
elevation._strategy: PER-THEME (CP2). LIGHT theme uses this shadow ramp. DARK theme is TONAL ONLY — carry depth via surface/default -> surface/raised and hold elevation at 0, because shadows read poorly on #030903.

0.note: flat — holds 1 invisible transparent drop shadow so the effect style is non-empty and publishable (R11); also the correct level for every dark-theme surface

effects._comment: Documented but NOT built as Figma Effect Styles this run. The focus indicator is implemented as a STROKE (semantic/color/border/focus + semantic/border-width/component-focus-ring), which is the accessible and email-portable form; the brand glows have no source evidence and would be an invention. Recorded so the decision is traceable — see gaps[].

focus/brand.note: superseded by the stroke-based focus ring; dark 6.21:1 / light 9.16:1, both clear the 3:1 non-text threshold

gradient._comment: The source file contains NO gradients — no gradient fills, no Paint Styles. Nothing extracted, nothing invented. 0 Paint Styles exist in the DS file.

motion._comment: 6 semantic pairs, each composited from one duration + one easing primitive, and each carrying a MANDATORY prefers-reduced-motion counterpart (WCAG 2.3.3). Components reference the pairs, never the raw primitives.

feedback/ai-processing.note: looping pulse/shimmer on agentic surfaces. Under prefers-reduced-motion the loop must STOP, not merely shorten — a 0ms duration with linear easing means no animation at all.

grid._comment: mobile 320 and tablet 800 are extracted (HIGH confidence). desktop 1280 is authored for gap G5. contentMaxWidth/pageGutter/catalogColumns/catalogGap are inferred from the 1280-wide source screens and are NOT tokenised as Variables — ADS-Styles-Author draws the '— Grid & Layout' page and should confirm them against the real screens.

gaps.reason: gap G8's description mentions a missing 48px step alongside the missing 24px one. Only 24 was mandated for this run, so 48 was NOT authored — 32→64 remains a coarse jump. Decide at QG1.

Alerts, badges and toasts currently have to use a SOLID status fill with color/text/on-status (verified accessible). A softer tinted background would need 8 pre-blended full-opacity primitives (opacity-tinted paints are ruled out by Gotcha V6, which breaks on instancing). Not invented without direction.
Decorative brand glows have no source evidence; documented above with inferred values but not built as Effect Styles.

The approved 5-step neutral ramp has no distinct value left for a third light-theme surface once surface/default=#edf3ed and surface/raised=#FFFFFF. In light theme #edf3ed already reads as the subtle fill on a white card; in dark theme it would collide with surface/raised. Not authored rather than duplicated.
No layout grids exist in the source file. Values in the grid block above are inferred from the 1280 screen width; ADS-Styles-Author must confirm.
